meta.tertiary: Separate from per-roll pools; notes require explicit eligibility handling

tertiary.name: Clue scroll (master)
notes: Clue scrolls will drop as scroll boxes after the completion of X Marks the Spot.

tertiary.name: Minor elite scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a minor elite scroll case on their 50th completed elite clue scroll ''or'' their first completed elite clue scroll if their clue count is above 50 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).

tertiary.name: Major elite scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a major elite scroll case on their 150th completed elite clue scroll ''or'' their first completed elite clue scroll if their clue count is above 150 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).

tertiary.name: Heavy casket
notes: Players will always receive a heavy casket on their 200th completed elite clue scroll ''or'' their first completed elite clue scroll if their clue count is above 200 (if the player has lost the item).

tertiary.name: Scroll sack
notes: Players will receive the scroll sack '''only''' on their 100th completed clue scroll (master), or if their clue count is above 100 and the player does not have the item.

tertiary.name: Minor master scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a minor master scroll case on their 25th completed master clue scroll ''or'' their first completed master clue scroll if their clue count is above 25 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).

tertiary.name: Major master scroll case
notes: Players will always receive a major master scroll case on their 75th completed master clue scroll ''or'' their first completed master clue scroll if their clue count is above 75 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).
